summary.zh: 从检索、整理到持续监测，快速了解临床试验监测平台的主要工作流。
summary.en: Learn the main workflows of the clinical trial monitoring workspace, from discovery and curation to ongoing monitoring.

description.zh: 建议按照“检索试验 → 保存搜索或加入项目 → 创建监测主题 → 查看动态”的顺序开始。
description.en: A useful first workflow is: find trials, save the search or add trials to a project, create a monitor, then review updates.

body.zh: 在顶部搜索框输入疾病、干预措施、申办方或注册号。试验页可进一步按来源、状态、分期等条件筛选；需要最新结果时可开启“实时查原站”。
body.en: Use the top search box for a disease, intervention, sponsor, or registry ID. Refine results by source, status, phase, and other filters; enable live source search when you need the latest registry results.

body.zh: 项目用于归集试验、保存的搜索、监测主题、笔记和证据。项目本身不会自动执行检索或监测。
body.en: Projects collect trials, saved searches, monitors, notes, and evidence. A project does not run searches or monitoring by itself.

description.zh: 把需要重复追踪的检索条件配置为监测主题，系统会记录试验进入、离开及字段变化。
description.en: Turn repeatable criteria into monitors that record trials entering or leaving the scope and changes to trial fields.

body.zh: 填写名称和匹配条件，选择手动、每小时、每日或每周运行。可随时暂停监测，历史运行记录仍会保留。
body.en: Set a name and matching criteria, then choose manual, hourly, daily, or weekly execution. Pausing a monitor keeps its run history intact.

body.zh: 动态页集中展示字段变化、通知和每日摘要；可按范围、时间窗口及严重程度筛选。
body.en: The Updates page combines field changes, notifications, and daily digests, with scope, time-window, and severity filters.

description.zh: 页面内容来自临床试验注册库及本地同步结果，使用时应同时关注数据时效性与来源差异。
description.en: Content comes from trial registries and locally synchronized records. Always consider freshness and cross-registry differences.

body.zh: 数据来源页会显示各注册库最近同步时间和健康状态。原站更新与本地入库之间可能存在延迟。
body.en: The Data Sources page shows the latest synchronization time and health of each registry. Registry changes may take time to reach the local index.

body.zh: 本平台用于信息检索、整理和变化监测，不替代注册库原始记录、医学判断或监管决策。关键结论请回到原始来源核验。
body.en: This workspace supports information discovery, organization, and change monitoring. It does not replace registry records, medical judgment, or regulatory decisions; verify critical conclusions at the original source.
